image_description: A translucent, pinkish plastic bib lying flat on a blue textured fabric surface. The bib features a complex, chaotic collage of printed graphics including geometric patterns (grids, stripes), abstract shapes, and what appears to be distorted text or logos. The material shows significant warping and reflection, suggesting a flexible plastic composition.

The internal patterns (stripes, grids) do not follow the curvature or perspective of the bib. They appear as a flat collage pasted onto a 3D object, causing visual dissonance.
The boundary of the neck hole is irregular and lacks the clean cut or reinforced edge expected of a manufactured plastic bib. It looks melted.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid lines warp and bend in ways that do not match the gentle curve of the bib, suggesting a failure in mapping 2D textures to 3D geometry.
